preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi < i for i in range(2, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each parent pi must be a valid vertex number less than the current vertex i.
The number of parent values must be exactly n - 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct possible colorings modulo 1000000007.
